title: sddm-theme: showlogo=shown has no effect
line: With showlogo=shown, the Breeze login screen now shows the logo at the top of the screen at all times, not only after the screen sits idle for a minute.
explanation: The Breeze SDDM theme gave the logo an opacity of 0 while the login UI was visible, so it could only appear after the UI faded out following 60 seconds without input. With a plain colour background the UI never fades, so the logo never appeared, and with an image most people never waited long enough to see it. The logo is now always visible at the top centre of the screen (where it no longer collides with the action buttons and footer at the bottom), and the clock is centred in the space between the logo and the user list.

commits.message:
sddm-theme: always show the logo when showlogo is set

The logo only appeared after the login UI faded out, which never happens
with a plain colour background, so showlogo=shown seemed to do nothing.
Show it at the top of the screen at all times, with the clock below it.

BUG: 468070

patches.diff:
From cfc2c004d98ce6bf5cc19c5bcdb0b974f82d3280 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:31:50 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] sddm-theme: always show the logo when showlogo is set

The logo only appeared after the login UI faded out, which never happens
with a plain colour background, so showlogo=shown seemed to do nothing.
Show it at the top of the screen at all times, with the clock below it.

BUG: 468070
---
 sddm-theme/Main.qml | 17 +++++------------
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 12 deletions(-)

diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..00fa7af0c0 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -135,9 +135,10 @@ Item {
         Clock {
             id: clock
             property Item shadow: clockShadow
-            visible: y > 0 && config.showClock === "true"
+            readonly property real spaceTop: logo.visible ? logo.y + logo.height : 0
+            visible: y > spaceTop && config.showClock === "true"
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-            y: (userListComponent.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2
+            y: (spaceTop + userListComponent.userList.y + mainStack.y)/2 - height/2
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignBaseline
         }
 
@@ -406,20 +407,12 @@ Item {
             visible: config.showlogo === "shown"
             source: config.logo
             anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-            anchors.bottom: footer.top
-            anchors.bottomMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+            anchors.top: parent.top
+            anchors.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
             asynchronous: true
             sourceSize.height: height
-            opacity: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible ? 0 : 1
             fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
             height: Math.round(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 3.5)
-            Behavior on opacity {
-                // OpacityAnimator when starting from 0 is buggy (it shows one frame with opacity 1)"
-                NumberAnimation {
-                    duration: Kirigami.Units.longDuration
-                    easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad
-                }
-            }
         }
 
         // Note: Containment masks stretch clickable area of their buttons to
--
